text:
With whooping howls, a dozen draffers break through the sparse cover on the Farplains in pursuit of prey. With cunning primal tactics, 
they run alongside herds of grazing beasts, forcing them into a long line as they nip and slash at their flanks. Over long miles they wear 
them down, the frail or young soon fall behind and the pursuing predators close in for the kill. With powerful legs they leap and slash 
with lateral bladed tusks, cutting deep wounds and bleeding their prey dry. As each herd beast collapses, draffer cubs pounce on the 
weakened animals in a frenzy as they furiously fi ght their litter kin for the choice meats, while the adults continue the pursuit onward, 
leaving a trail of carcasses in their wake for the pack to feast on.

Encountering Despite its fearsome appearance the draffer lives 
in a tight familial pack, roaming across the colder Tundrus 
highlands caring for their young whilst on the move. Th ough 
a voracious pursuit predator, they will favor somewhat fresh 
carrion when the opportunity arises. Travelers who offer such 
grim gifts could pique their interest, often dispelling the initial 
aggressive demeanor they would display to other creatures.
